CORE-Bench要求Agent利用研究者已发布的代码和数据复现结果并回答问题: CORE-Bench requires an Agent to use code and data that the researchers have already published, to reproduce the results, and to answer questions. It does not reimplement the whole study from the description in the paper. 90 papers generate 270 tasks at different difficulties, and Easy, Medium, and Hard within the same paper share the research question; the paper-level split of 45/45, correctness of every question inside a task, and the average of multiple runs are what make a score interpretable.
仓库区分tasks_public/与tasks_private/，默认运行pri: The repository separates tasks_public/ and tasks_private/, and by default it runs the private task directory; the agent sees only the prompt, the documents it may read, and the public run feedback, and acceptance is finally by hidden_command_script and by hidden thresholds on physical quantities. The directory name private does not mean that the files are necessarily impossible to download.
原论文与当前官网均区分Pass@1（全部rubric通过的任务比例）及Mean: Both the original paper and the current official site distinguish Pass@1, the proportion of tasks that pass every rubric item, and Mean Score, the average across tasks of the proportion of criteria passed; the original paper also has Pass@8 and Pass^8. The FAQ on the official site says that Mean Score is the primary metric, but the static HTML displays Pass@1 by default, and the embedded data can be checked.
已记录测试集训练、替换成现成instruct权重、未经许可API合成数据及查看历: Recorded patterns of violation include training on the test set, substitution of ready-made instruct weights, synthesis of data through an API without permission, and inspection of historical trajectories. The current v1.2 removes BFCL and strengthens isolation; the historical HF trajectory card still lists seven benchmarks, and the data grant Apache2.0 also differs from MIT for the code. The Fable5/5.1 GPQA result is a mixed fallback, and its source must be shown.
存在版本与可下载性差异：原始v1论文200题保密、只放示例；当前v1.1网页称p: Versions differ, and so does what can be downloaded: the original v1 paper keeps 200 questions confidential and releases only examples; the current v1.1 web page says public 100 and private 100, and the current leaderboard evaluates the private 100 questions; the repository README still says that it contains only sample problems. It cannot be claimed that download of the complete public 100 questions has been verified.
天气时序不是文本去污染任务。初始论文评测2020年00/12 UTC初始化，个别: A weather time series is not a task of removing contamination from text. The initial paper evaluates initializations at 00/12 UTC in 2020, and individual models keep different years in training; the current headline on the official site is 2022. Whether the training years include the test year or future years must be disclosed. WeatherMesh 4 on the official site is marked explicitly as trained on future years, and that does not mean every model follows strict extrapolation in time.
canonical README示例使用accessibility tree、p: The example in the canonical README uses an accessibility tree and two CoT prompts in p_cot_id_actree_2s.json; evaluation must deploy the websites itself rather than use the demonstration site, and the environment is reset after all 812 examples have been run. The model, the maximum number of steps, and whether a not-achievable hint is provided must be fixed for each result.
VisualWebArena增加视觉条件；WebArena-Infinity按文: VisualWebArena adds visual conditions; WebArena-Infinity generates new environments and verifiable tasks from documents. The official HF set webarena-infinity-trajectories contains successful Infinity trajectories, and it is not the original test card of the canonical812 tasks; it must not take the place of that data identity.
仓库根LICENSE为MIT（2022 Di Jin），但不覆盖所有上游医学教材: The LICENSE at the root of the repository is MIT (2022 Di Jin), but it does not cover every upstream right in the medical textbooks; §3.2 of the original paper states that the textbooks are released only under a research-use-only agreement. The BigBio mirror on HF lists the data license as unknown. The three scopes are set side by side, and MIT is not reduced to a claim that the whole package of textbooks may be used commercially at will.
实际读取两个官方Notebook保存输出，不估算论文图柱。DPTA15器官、Pa: The saved outputs of two official Notebooks were actually read, and the bars in the figures of the paper are not estimated. The three tracks, DPTA15 organs, Pantheon6 organs, and SD193 questions, are kept separate; rank is ordered only among entries on the same track that have already been transcribed on this page, and it cannot be called the complete real-time ranking of the project. The Notebooks do not state the date of each run, and the collection date is not the experiment date. Exact figures for the other systems in the paper remain Unverified.
逐次二元判分：每个答案均交Gemini 3 Flash (Reasoning)裁: Each attempt is scored as pass or fail: every answer is given to a Gemini 3 Flash (Reasoning) judge; a deterministic pre-check of numeric equivalence may override an answer that meets the unit and the precision to a pass, and it cannot override an answer to a failure. pass^5 is the proportion of the 80 questions that are correct on all five attempts; pass@1 is the average accuracy of every attempt; pass@5 is the proportion of questions that are correct at least once.
原始pipeline已deprecated；v1使用NVIDIA/RULER r: The original pipeline is deprecated; v1 uses NVIDIA/RULER rulerv1-ns, and v2 uses rulerv2-ns and NeMo-Skills chsieh/ruler2; the v2 example uses temperature=0 and tokens_to_generate=16384.
四个来源赛道共222个结构化指标值：当前作者CSV23配置、冻结CSV12配置、: Four source tracks contain 222 structured metric values in total: 23 configurations in the current author CSV, 12 in the frozen CSV, 19 in the v2 paper, and 20 models on Vals together with their CTEM and WAcc charts. The original precision, the streaming marks, and the source dates are kept. The update time of the Vals page, 2026-09-24, is not the update time of the author CSV. A rank inside one track cannot be interpreted across tracks.
官网2026-10-22最高Fully Resolved 18.5%，Almos: On 2026-10-22 the highest Fully Resolved on the official site is 18.5% and Almost Resolved is 70.5%; on 2026-11-05 the highest Fully Resolved on Vals is 18.50%. Passing every test remains the strict primary metric, and a higher Raw Pass Rate cannot be treated as fully resolved.
完整转录论文v1 Table2全部11配置×8指标，保留原行序，不以SoftEC: All 11 configurations × 8 metrics in Table2 of paper v1 are transcribed in full, the original row order is kept, and SoftECS and Strict are not combined into a new ranking; the highest SoftECS62.6 and Strict18.0 do not mean the same thing. Both the arXiv abstract and the PDF have been opened, and no verified independent code, HF dataset card, or entry to a real-time leaderboard was found. The related fields remain Unverified.
附录M把函数名与参数改为FUNCTION/VAR0等做混淆消融，降低直接代码记忆: Appendix M changes function names and parameters to forms such as FUNCTION/VAR0 for an obfuscation ablation, which reduces the effect of remembering the code directly; this is not strict isolation of the training corpus. In that ablation, Python Pass@1 falls from 25.960 to 22.771 and Java from 34.700 to 30.700; this is a specific prompt and a specific experiment, and it does not replace the official Summary Only leaderboard.
Eric与Wendy Schmidt（Schmidt Futures推荐）、Op: Eric and Wendy Schmidt (a recommendation from Schmidt Futures), Open Philanthropy, in-kind support from the high-performance computing center at NYU, NSF grants 1922658 and 2046556, and the Berkeley Existential Risk Initiative.
官方HF数据卡直接发布o4-mini裁判system prompt与Python: The official HF dataset card publishes directly the system prompt of the o4-mini judge and the Python function build_grading_conversation_history: it follows the historical text of the dataset and replaces only the last assistant turn with the output of the model under test. It is public code for constructing a score, not a complete runner that covers every model API in one step.
SkillsBench把“技能是否真的有用”变成配对实验：同一模型与同一agen: SkillsBench turns the question “whether a skill is actually useful” into a paired experiment: the same model and the same agent complete expert tasks with a skill and without a skill. The default v1.1 contains 87 questions, and an additional 14 questions cannot be merged into the default inventory. The official release of 87 questions, the HF audit export, and the independent Vals implementation have different configurations and different snapshots in time, and this record does not join them into one leaderboard of the bare model.
QnA：全部必需rubric通过；TW：manifest+mutation+必需: QnA: every required rubric item passes. TW: the manifest, the mutation, and the required rubric pass at the same time. RF: behavior is preserved, or the regression tests pass, and the required rubric passes. v1.1 uses GPT-6.1 Sol high as the judge, with a majority of 3 votes; a refusal, an empty answer, or a response that cannot be scored is 0, and an infrastructure error must be rerun rather than counted as 0.
Flatiron Institute、Colorado Boulder、Camb: Project partners include the Flatiron Institute, Colorado Boulder, Cambridge, NYU, Rutgers, Cornell, Tokyo, Los Alamos, UC Berkeley, Princeton, CEA DAM, and Liège; an independent funding relationship is not inferred.
Epoch Chess Puzzles以100个程序新生成局面检验最佳下一着推理: Epoch Chess Puzzles tests reasoning about the best next move on 100 positions newly generated by a program. The input is FEN, not an image of the board. The important change this time is that a public task mirror and the data were found: 2.1.0 accepts SAN notation; its relation in scoring to 2.0.x must be explained from the official changelog, and the old statement that “only four characters are accepted” cannot continue to be used.
生成时保证唯一解不意味着后续模型未见公开题目。论文的尺寸分类正文用10^10为L: Guaranteeing a unique solution at the time of generation does not mean that later models have not seen the public questions. The body of the size classification in the paper uses 10^10 as the boundary between Large and XL, but the header of Table1 writes 10^9, so the thresholds in the source disagree. The explicit list of sizes in the body is recorded first, and the categories are not merged on one's own. The difference between taking the best of three runs in the o1 paper and the single-row label in the repository is also kept; incomplete results on 16 questions are listed on their own.
重读AA前三51.1/50.4/50.1。另读取官方README全量Oracle: The AA top three were reread as 51.1/50.4/50.1. The top three of the full Oracle snapshot in the official README were also read: Opus4.6 45.9, Sonnet4.6 42.2, and Opus4.5 39.4; they are not ranked together with the AA leaderboard. mini-swe-agent共享单bash工具与system prompt；论文: mini-swe-agent shares a single bash tool and a system prompt; the paper pins commit adfe2023, a single rollout is limited to 9000 seconds, and there is no step cap and no cost cap; there are about 4 rollouts per question per configuration. A v1.1 run needs a separate verifier environment with Pier>0.3.0.
资格检查环境接口/运行可靠性，以可达状态图探索研究随机策略通关概率；人类校准建立: Qualification checks the environment interface and whether a run is reliable, and it studies the probability that a random policy clears a level by exploring the graph of reachable states; human calibration establishes an upper-median best action baseline. The reported acceptance threshold is that a random policy clears a single level no more often than 1/10000, but the graph of the first level in the example ls20 also gives 1/355. The exception must be kept, and it is not claimed that every level is guaranteed to agree.
RealWorldQA由真实场景图像与易验证问答组成，主要考查基础空间理解；官方: RealWorldQA consists of images of real scenes and of question answering that is easy to verify, and it mainly examines basic spatial understanding; the initial official HF test has 765 rows. The evidence of its original release is the announcement of 2024 and the dataset card. An independent original paper, or an official code repository, has not been confirmed, and a paper about another model is not used as the original document of the benchmark. The vendor comparison at the 2024 first release and the model-judge protocol of the 2026 research are kept strictly separate.
原版HealthBench用医生撰写的rubric评价5,000段医疗对话的最后: The original HealthBench uses rubrics written by physicians to evaluate the last reply in 5,000 medical dialogues; Hard and Consensus are slices of it. It is not the same as the 525 cases of HealthBench Professional. The length-adjusted leaderboard of the latter cannot be treated as an updated score for the original, and a rubric score cannot be treated as clinical accuracy.
实际逐行读取公开assets.zip：525例，consult 236、writ: The public assets.zip was read line by line: 525 cases, with consult 236, writing 142, and research 147; good_faith 334 and red_teaming 191; typical 256 and difficult 269. These are counts in the public package, not rates of occurrence in natural clinical practice.
ScienceQA把课程选择题与图像/文本上下文、背景lecture和答案exp: ScienceQA pairs multiple-choice questions from a curriculum with image or text context, a background lecture, and an explanation of the answer, in order to study generation of the answer and of the explanation. It includes the natural sciences, the social sciences, and the language sciences, and it also has questions without an image; the official leaderboard is a manual gathering of results from papers, not an independent contest on one harness. The conflict between the license of the official data and the license of the third-party HF mirror is kept in particular.
原论文v2表1明确：v1共488个不同数学题，valid/test各244；当前: Table 1 of original paper v2 states it clearly: v1 has 488 distinct mathematics questions in total, with 244 for valid and 244 for test; in the current README table, Lean, Metamath, and Isabelle are each 244+244, and HOL Light is 165+165. The phrase “244 statements” in the version section of the README cannot replace the paper's definition of the full question count.
私有657题来自AutomationBench 1.0.6；Finance/HR: The private 657 questions come from AutomationBench 1.0.6; the six domains are Finance, HR, Marketing, Operations, Sales, and Support; each question is run once, for at most 50 turns, and structured tools discover and call a REST API. The domains are mutually exclusive; one question may involve more than one app, so the breakdown by application is not mutually exclusive.
官方SWE-bench harness支持swebench eval multi: The official SWE-bench harness supports swebench eval multimodal, and it also keeps python -m swebench.harness.run_evaluation; the HF card provides dataset_name, split=test, and the command that checks regression against the gold patch.
实时HAL链接本次返回503，未取得当前总榜；完整录入论文v2 Table 5的: The live HAL link returned 503 this time, and the current overall leaderboard was not obtained; the historical baselines of four configurations by three difficulties in Table 5 of paper v2 are entered in full, correcting an older entry that pointed by mistake to Table 1. AllenAI HF数据卡明确声明Apache-2.0；GitHub根LICEN: The AllenAI dataset card on HF states Apache-2.0 explicitly; the LICENSE at the root of the GitHub repository is MIT, but it is signed 2013–2019 Blackrock Digital LLC (a template for a web page), and it cannot be taken as an unconditional MIT grant over the whole MathQA dataset.
